item: T1: ARMv8-A AArch32 (Cortex-A55) admission and decode
build: make rpi4-bolt-test RPI4_ARM_CPU=cortex-a55 (TOOLCHAIN=clang, -mcpu=cortex-a55 -mfpu=none); Tag_CPU_arch v8-A; 0 VFP/NEON
baseline_pi: 18/18 sinks equal the independent oracle (A72, AArch32, Non-secure SVC)

admission.rejected: exception vectors/startup, bcopy+bzero fallthrough, vsnprintf (R12): same classes as the v7 build

rewritten_pi.result: 2 runs x 18 sinks: 0 mismatches vs the independent oracle; no faults

finding_r13: 16 bolt_bench Thumb functions (incl. bolt_bench_memcpy) start with a 16-bit instruction when built for cortex-a55 and cannot be redirected until R13

tests.arm_lit: 50/50 (new arm-v8-aarch32.test; arm-isa-contract.test now admits armv8a and checks v8 runtime vs v7 input)

scope: uncertified until the user approves a pi4 contract for this image
